purpose: Test whether causal feature combinations known at actual entry disproportionately identify losing trades and can improve payoff/PF when removed, across current M5/M15/H1 payoff architectures.

data.sample: same frozen 2023-01-03 through 2026-06-19 GOLD historical CSV family used by M10A deterministic reproduction

anti_leakage.features: actual-entry-time causal only; latest fully closed M1/M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 information plus reclaim timing/price context and entry spread

M5.architecture: M10A M5 0.15 ATR5 / 6m reclaim + M15-MACD selective runner75 + one-position

M15.architecture: M9X W1 0.10 ATR5 / 10m + H1-MACD selective runner50 + N6 half-risk + operational one-position correction

H1.architecture: M10A H1 0.05 ATR1H with M5 confirmation / 30m + H4&D1-MACD selective runner50 + one-position

search_method.compound_search: quantile conjunction mining plus shallow decision-tree interactions, maximum depth 3
search_method.selection_policy: candidate generation/ranking on 2023-2024 only; 2025 validation; 2026 final test; no rule promoted from final-test optimization

M5_result.note: Several 2023-2024 patterns improved 2025 but reversed in 2026. Do not freeze an M5 exclusion from this audit.

M15_result.note: No M15 conjunction passed the strict 2023-2024 discovery to 2025 PF+payoff validation gate. Keep current M15 payoff research unchanged.

family_A_broad.interpretation: H1 LONG entry while latest closed M5 MACD momentum is rolling down and M5 EMA20-EMA40 trend-stack strength is not exceptionally high.
family_A_broad.warning: Broad holdout support exists, but 2024 payoff does not improve across the family. Treat as loss-tail/quality evidence, not a frozen filter.

family_B_payoff_stronger_but_narrower.interpretation: Exclude H1 LONG entries when latest closed M5 MACD slope is negative while the H1 EMA30-EMA40 positive stack is already large, consistent with a higher-timeframe uptrend undergoing short-term momentum rollover.

neighborhood.warning: Robustness is concentrated near H1 EMA30-EMA40 around 17.5 bps; this family is promising but parameter-narrow.

family_C_higher_tf_overextension.interpretation: Exclude H1 LONG entries when the latest closed H4 5-bar return and D1 1-bar return are simultaneously strongly positive, consistent with overextended higher-timeframe momentum/chasing.

neighborhood.warning: Improvement concentrates near D1 return around 140 bps. Treat as secondary evidence only.

forward_policy.next: If H1 compound-loss filtering is pursued, first make a deterministic reproduction stage from the frozen six historical CSV hashes, then freeze a separate new fresh prospective comparison arm. Do not retrofit the current M10B H1 arm.
